svg.text: Planet seed 7 (pictures A2 to F) as a flat map: longitude across, latitude down (the poles are stretched).
Names from Narrative's grammar with Legal's blocklist applied. They are proposals for Legal to screen and Orb to change.
Bellgate is the hub (the city nearest the others); Kilnstead the town nearest it, Farwatch the farthest, Netmend the one on the coast:
the old planet's names, kept where the geography matches. The other 10 cities and 30 towns come from the grammar and each place's seed.
